# Ra.One: Summary
**Ra.One** is an Indian science fiction action film centered on Shekhar Subramaniam, a game programmer in London. Tasked with creating a unique game, he builds a virtual world with a supervillain—Ra.One—who is more powerful than the hero, G.One. Utilizing new technology, the game’s antagonist, Ra.One, equipped with artificial intelligence and advanced powers such as shapeshifting and mind reading, escapes into the real world in pursuit of Shekhar’s son, Prateek (aka Lucifer). After Ra.One kills Shekhar and others, G.One is brought into reality to protect Prateek and Sonia, leading to numerous confrontations between the two digital entities across London and Mumbai. Ultimately, G.One defeats Ra.One with help from Prateek, and returns to the digital world, only to be restored in the real world months later.
The cast includes Shah Rukh Khan (in dual roles as Shekhar and G.One), Arjun Rampal (as Ra.One), Kareena Kapoor (as Sonia), and Armaan Verma (as Prateek), with cameo appearances from Priyanka Chopra, Sanjay Dutt, Amitabh Bachchan, and Rajinikanth. Directed by Anubhav Sinha and produced by Red Chillies Entertainment, the film was notable for its high production values, extensive visual effects, and 3D conversion requiring hundreds of artists. Ra.One featured international collaborations, a strong marketing campaign, and was released widely in multiple languages and formats. While the film received praise for its visual effects and box office records, reviews were mixed regarding its story and direction. Ra.One won several awards, including National Film Award and Filmfare Award for Best Special Effects. There has been ongoing speculation about a sequel, with varying opinions in the industry and some pre-production reported but no confirmed release plans.
